title: AppDatabase XRs never become Ready
scenario: After the move to Crossplane v2 namespaced XRs, every team's AppDatabase sits at Ready=False and no Cloud SQL instance appears. A colleague wants to add a JSON key secret because the provider logged a token warning. RDM onboards next week. You get the XRD, Composition, provider config, team XRs, trace and describe output, and a render-and-reconcile simulator.
task: Reproduce with make reconcile and read the composed resources' conditions
Explain why the MRs cannot find their provider config although one named default exists
Fix it once in the platform so any new team namespace works, without keys
Root cause, evidence and prevention in ANSWER.md
acceptance: riq-scores, mdm-golden and a new team-rdm XR all become Ready
Composition mappings (tier, version, deletion policy, connection secret) unchanged
Still v2: namespaced XRD, no claims, Pipeline mode; credentials stay Workload Identity
Root cause and evidence in ANSWER.md; the token warning ruled out

practices.label: Week 4 - Crossplane v2: namespaced XRs and MRs, providers
